biotools.summary: HematoMap is an R-based package for identifying and visualizing lineage aberrations in leukemia from single-cell and bulk RNA sequencing data. It provides a curated reference hierarchy of normal hematopoiesis and tools for mapping leukemic cells to their normal counterparts.
